missions.listEmpty: No missions in this list yet.

missionsCreate.title: Request transport
missionsCreate.intro: Use this when a lot is ready to leave the farm. You should have reported harvest in Harvest first, and operations can confirm the plan in their admin. Then pack the lot, complete quality, and open this screen. This sends a transport request: it stays PENDING until operations assigns a driver, or a logistics partner claims it. Materials and compliance are checked on the server — errors explain what to fix.
missionsCreate.workflowStep1: 1) Report harvest — the team sees your plan (dates, channel, expected quantity).
missionsCreate.workflowStep2: 2) They confirm what to prepare and coordinate with you (admin "Harvest plans" + notes to you in process).
missionsCreate.workflowStep3: 3) When the lot is packed (PACKED / quality done), enter pickup here. Operations sets the delivery route in the admin panel — you do not see the buyer destination.
missionsCreate.multiFarmTitle: Two farms, one buyer order (e.g. 800 kg + 200 kg)
missionsCreate.multiFarmBody: One trip = one batch. Each grower sends their own request for their lot. Operations links related runs and assigns logistics; you do not enter the final delivery address.
missionsCreate.opsRouteBoxBody: You only share farm pickup details here. BioVera operations assigns the carrier and enters the full drop-off for drivers.
missionsCreate.noBatchesBody: No batch is ready for transport yet. Finish packing, quality, and compliance photos first — then the lot appears here.
missionsCreate.locationHintDenied: Allow location to fill GPS and address, or enter them manually below.
missionsCreate.locationHintGps: GPS saved. If address is empty, type the full farm pickup address.
missionsCreate.locationHintFailed: Could not read GPS. Enter latitude, longitude, and address manually.
missionsCreate.pickupCoordsFreedomNote: Pickup GPS can be the farm gate or yard — you do not need to be there when you submit. The server only checks that coordinates are valid numbers, not that you are inside the parcel map.
missionsCreate.whereItGoes: Where it goes (logistics and drivers need this). Use the same city name on each run you want to combine on one truck.
missionsCreate.packagingComplianceChecking: Checking packing proof for the selected batch…
missionsCreate.packagingComplianceWhy: "Quality confirmed" here means your quality entry for the batch is done — it is separate from packing proof for transport. To request a truck the server also requires the three Bio Vera packing photos plus one verified label roll tied to this batch (material-control rule).
missionsCreate.packagingComplianceMissingSticker: No label roll has been recorded for this batch yet.
missionsCreate.packagingComplianceOk: Packing proof is complete — you can request transport.
missionsCreate.packagingComplianceUnchecked: Could not refresh packing status. If your request fails, finish photos and roll on the packing compliance screen.
missionsCreate.packagingIncompleteBody: This batch is missing packing proof (photos and/or label roll). Use "Open packing compliance" or Profile → Packing compliance.

alerts.batchRequiredBody: Choose a batch that is packed and ready for transport.
alerts.destinationCityBody: Enter destination city (for dispatch; same city can go on one truck).
alerts.destinationAddressBody: Enter the full delivery address (buyer, hub, dock).
alerts.locationBody: Use “Use my location” or enter latitude and longitude.

missionsCreate.successBody: Your request was sent. Operations will assign a driver; track status under Missions.
missionsCreate.serverError: Server error while requesting transport. Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, contact support.
missionsCreate.transportNetworkError: Could not reach the server (offline, DNS, or timeout). Check your internet and tap send again.

growthJournal.screenIntro: Pick your field, an approved parcel, and a crop plan. For plantings: you must submit a journal entry about every ~18 days (server-configurable) — photo on the parcel, GPS, growth stage, and notes on progress. For harvest plans, stage and short notes remain optional.
growthJournal.noPlansForParcel: You have no crop plan on this parcel yet. Open “Harvest & plan” and add a new planting or harvest plan for an approved parcel first.
growthJournal.noLogs: No growth logs for this filter
growthJournal.addPhotosToTrack: Pick parcel and crop plan above, then tap the camera. One photo each time.
growthJournal.addLogContext: Field: {{estate}}. Parcel: {{parcel}}. Crop plan: {{plan}}. Next step is mandatory: one photo on the parcel with GPS — required for every entry.
growthJournal.notesLabelPlanting: How the planting is progressing (required, min. 15 characters)
growthJournal.photoRequiredLineBody: Every entry must include a photo taken on the parcel. Tap below to open the camera and GPS capture.
growthJournal.addLogFooter: GPS must match the field; the photo is stored with a tamper-evident hash. Together with your parcel and crop plan, this builds the traceability chain for the passport.
growthJournal.imageUnavailable: Image not available (legacy URL or offline)
growthJournal.tapForDetail: Tap for full detail and map
growthJournal.noApprovedParcelsOnField: No approved parcels on this field yet. Add blocks under My parcels or wait for admin approval.
growthJournal.hintPickParcel: To enable the camera: choose a specific parcel below (not “All”). The photo is tied to that plot in the passport chain.
growthJournal.hintPickPlan: Choose a planting or harvest plan on that parcel. If the list is empty, open Harvest & plan and register a plan first.
growthJournal.stepsReminder: Flow: parcel → crop plan → camera. Uses the same parcel and plan as Field log.
growthJournal.passportLinkedLine: This entry is tied to the parcel and plan above; the photo and GPS become part of the digital passport growth evidence.

settings.languageDescription: Choose English or Serbian. The entire app (producer, buyer, and shared screens) uses this language. Your choice is saved on this device.

settings.aboutAlertBody: Version {{version}}. Traceability and field tools for certified growers. Data sync and GPS preferences on this page are stored only on this device.

sync.itemsNotSentHint: Often: GPS outside the farm/parcel in the server — fix map or record on the plot; see errors on each pending entry.
sync.fieldEntryNeedsParcelPlan: This queued entry was saved before parcel and crop plan were required. Open the field diary, choose parcel and plan, and save again — or delete the old queue item from Home.

fieldLogForm.introLead: First choose parcel and crop plan, then activity, material (quantity optional), notes, photo of the material or step, and finally GPS. Transport and packing can be logged away from the plot; for planting, fertilizing and spraying we warn if GPS is outside the saved parcel map.
fieldLogForm.materialKindPrompt: What are you registering? Tap first — then scan or enter the barcode.
fieldLogForm.warningNotOnParcel: Warning: your GPS fix is outside the farm/parcel map shapes saved on the server (not the address text). Move to the plot or redraw the parcel to include this point.
fieldLogForm.historySubtitle: Date, activity, and sync status. After a successful upload the row stays here as “Sent”.

errors.databaseSchemaOutOfDate:
The server database is missing an update — migrations probably were not applied (this is usually not caused by wrong data you typed on this screen).

What to fix: deploy the latest API code and run on the API environment: npx prisma migrate deploy (with production DATABASE_URL). After that, try again.
errors.databaseSchemaHintForSupport: If you contact support, include the timestamp and API path shown in the error detail.
